why: Every form row must carry label, description and error by construction; shutterflow has FormRow in 19 files and 2.x merges three row components.
what: New in packages/basalt-ui/src/controls/: form-field*, form-row* with tests and a layout test. Also deletes the 2.x form-layout.tsx (FormSection, FormRow, FormGroup, FormActions) and panel-row.tsx (PanelRow) with css and tests; a file outside owns that still imports one stays, with a signal.
must_not_touch: contract-pins.json, MIGRATING, llms.txt, check-budgets except areas/surface.ts
contract: Read docs/v3/concepts/controls-url-state.md 4.10, 4.12, 7, 9 (S7) and state-persistence-forms.md 6 (FieldLike). Built on ui/field (Base UI Field) and the v3-ctl-4 renderers (an ancestor).
exemplar: Follow src/ui/field.tsx and src/controls/control-view* for anatomy, data-slot names and the home size rule.
change: One concern: FormField and FormRow. FormField: required `label` (type), description, always-mounted error live region, accessible name per row; XOR props `field` (FieldLike, submit forms) and `control` (ControlHandle, instant-apply prefs); first error by record order; fieldErrors envelope structural. Required mark = a visible `*` glyph plus `required` on the Base UI Field (aria-required), never colour alone; no new message key. Dirty dot: derived from `control.isDefault` being false; the `field` form shows none, since FieldLike has no default or dirty state and ports.ts is frozen. FormRow lays rows out by container tier, repeatable for arrays. Resolve S7: prove Base UI triggers honour `<fieldset disabled>`, else the part carries `disabled` via Field context. Ships: rule = control-home treats FormField as a home (fixture in v3-ctl-8-lint) and a missing `label` is a type error; skill snippet = JSDoc @example for both symbols; tests = form-field.test.tsx, form-row.test.tsx, layout test. A new public value symbol also lands, in this Issue, its raise in scripts/check-budgets/areas/surface.ts (the ceiling +1 and a `raises` row with from, to, consumer and repo) and its name in scripts/consumers.json (`<symbol>: <repo>:<path>`); make check refuses the symbol without them. The shard is scripts/export-surface/controls.json, written by `export-surface.mjs --update`.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution; make sync-self its own commit.
proof: tests/layout/form-field.layout.test.ts at 1440, 768, 390, 320 with long labels and errors; axe serious and critical clean.
acceptance: make check passes and `bun test src/controls/form-field src/controls/form-row` is green, tests red first.
A FormField without `label` fails tsc via @ts-expect-error; passing both `field` and `control` does too.
A disabled fieldset disables ui/select, combobox, switch, checkbox, number-field and slider inside a FormField (test per control).
The error region exists before any error and announces a changed message; the required mark is not colour-only; the dirty dot shows for a non-default `control` and never for `field` (tests).
The layout test passes at 1440, 768, 390 and 320 with no overflow and 44 px coarse hit floors.
form-layout.tsx and panel-row.tsx are gone; `rg "@mantine/|@tanstack/react-form" src/controls/form-*` finds nothing.
`git diff --name-only` lists only owned paths, the generated packages/basalt-ui/docs/{form-field,form-row}.md, and the sync-self commit.
out_of_scope: FormFooter, toSubmitErrors, useFormDraft (v3-state-4a-controls), Section, migration rows (v3-ctl-9-rows).
